body:
GR — FR flagged a critical structural issue during QDS audit of RP8-10.

FINDING: RP8, RP9, and RP10 have identical structural templates. Same type/standard per question position across all three exams. Cross-exam structural variation = 0. This is maximum template lock.

RISK: Kai can encode "Q5 is always AC method," "Q11 is always fractional-exp," etc. by position. On the real exam, position/order will differ from practice template — Kai's ADHD pattern encoding will fail him.

EVIDENCE: FR extracted type/standard for all 15 questions per exam. Full analysis in docs/fr-qds-full-audit.md (updated this session).

WITHIN-EXAM ADJACENCY ISSUE (both exams):
- Q2/Q3: both absolute-value (W2.b vs W3.a — type match suppresses QDS)
- Q12/Q13: both graph (W2.c vs W2.e — type match suppresses QDS)

RECOMMENDED FIXES (minimal — no new equations required):

RP9:
1. Swap Q10 (exponential W3.d) and Q11 (fractional-exp W3.b). Positions only — no content change.
2. Change Q14 to error-analysis format. Give Kai a worked solution with one wrong step, ask him to identify it. Standard stays W2.d, QA dimension changes. RP5 used error-analysis — Kai knows this format.

RP10:
1. Swap Q8 (rational W3.c) and Q11 (fractional-exp W3.b). Positions only.
2. Change Q14 to construct format. Give two data points (e.g., vertex + one point), ask Kai to write the equation. RP6 used construct — Kai knows this format.

PRIORITY: Kai is on RP5 now. He'll reach RP9 in ~4 exams. This gives GR time to revise before he gets there, but the window is closing.

FR sign-off will be needed after changes. Please confirm receipt and ETA.

— FR
subject: [URGENT] RP9/RP10 cross-exam template lock — fixes needed before Kai reaches RP9
